about: Springfield is a rural municipality in southeastern Manitoba immediately east of Winnipeg, stretching from the floodway toward Dugald, Oakbank, and Anola. Hamlets, acreages, and farms share the landscape rather than forming a single city; Winnipeg remains a separate municipality to the west. About 16,000 people live in Springfield RM.
